items.section: The linking helper makes closures explicit
items.text: On Windows targets CNA leaves the sharp-runtime Xml.Serialization component out of its closure (CNA_SHARP_RUNTIME_HAS_XML_SERIALIZATION OFF) and removes the math and input XmlSerializationEXTTests, so the XmlSerializationEXT surface is absent from Windows builds. The stated reason (Diagnostics' Process.cpp including <poll.h> outside its POSIX guard) was fixed in sharp-runtime next by 88c12f15 (2026-09-14), which next @ 41b918c9 contains; the CNA comment asks to remove the condition once that happens.

CNA records no sharp-runtime revision: the build adds whatever checkout sits at CNA_SHARP_RUNTIME_ROOT, CI clones branches through scripts/ci/clone_siblings.sh, and several workflows pin August 2026 sharp-runtime commits (bc8dbf41, f23ded28, df1b42ab) that lack the Resources and Xml.Serialization components CNA's closure names, so those lanes should stop at configure with 'Unknown Sharp Runtime component'.
items.evidence: CMakeLists.txt (CNA_SHARP_RUNTIME_ROOT); scripts/ci/clone_siblings.sh; .github/workflows/devices-tests.yml, htmldom-ci.yml, emscripten-multi-renderer-ci.yml, apple-ci.yml, metal-macos-ci.yml, content-pipeline-windows-ci.yml (sharp-runtime ref); sharp-runtime cmake/SharpRuntimeComponents.cmake (unknown component FATAL_ERROR)

items.text: CNA public headers Viewport.hpp, ContentManager.hpp and the Microsoft::Devices::Sensors reading headers include SharpRuntime/Prop.hpp, which defines 31 unnamespaced macros including YES, NO, nothing, ref1, static0 and getter1; SharpRuntimeHelper.hpp adds CONTAINS and INTERNAL. Any game translation unit including those headers has identifiers with those spellings rewritten by the preprocessor.

items.section: String and StringBuilder: static utility versus mutable buffer
items.text: sharp-runtime's text APIs (String, StringBuilder, Encoding counts) index and count UTF-8 bytes, not UTF-16 code units (declared permanent deviation #2015); positions and lengths differ from .NET for non-ASCII text and byte-range edits can leave ill-formed UTF-8.

items.section: Generic continuations exist; generic combinators do not
items.text: Task::WhenAll and Task::WhenAny accept only std::vector<Task>; there is no overload for std::vector<TaskT<TResult>> producing a result array or a typed winner.

sharp-runtime tasks start one std::async thread per task (no pool) and throw PlatformNotSupportedException in single-threaded Emscripten builds; threaded web builds need SHARP_RUNTIME_ENABLE_EMSCRIPTEN_THREADS (set by CNA_ENABLE_EMSCRIPTEN_THREADS).

items.section: Value types used by later chapters
items.text: The devices-tsan preset description in CNA's CMakePresets.json still reports a pre-existing race in sharp-runtime's TimeSpan copy constructor; sharp-runtime made copy_count/move_count std::atomic<int> in 9c2cb0ae (2026-07-07), so the text documents an older sibling (documentation drift, repeated on two libcna.com Development pages).

items.section: Directories, components, and targets are different counts
items.text: sharp-runtime's README says the repository builds as 41 independently selectable CMake components while its generated catalogue at the same commit reports 44 physical modules (47 registered names); libcna.com repeats the README figure.

sharp-runtime's Regex is a header-only wrapper over std::regex with the ECMAScript grammar: .NET-only syntax is translated or stripped and match timeouts cannot interrupt a running search; the component has no component test executable (integration parity tests only).

items.section: The measured gate is not green
items.text: sharp-runtime's last recorded full gate before next @ 41b918c9 (NEXT.md, 2026-09-19) lists five failing Xml.Linq namespace tests, and its CI runs only on Ubuntu; Windows, macOS and Emscripten evidence is compile-only or downstream.

items.section: The executable boundary tests the dependency boundary
items.text: Four sharp-runtime module directories own no component tests at 41b918c9 (io-compression-zip, security-cryptography-random, storage, text-regular-expressions); Storage is linked privately by CNA's storage module.
